result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major content defect showing a meaningless discount and a minor styling inconsistency in the favorite icons.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card displays a '-0%' discount badge, which represents a meaningless/zero discount and appears to be a data or formatting error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the value is 0%, or display the correct promotional discount value.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon styling is inconsistent between cards: the Tokumaru Ramen card shows a white circular background with an outline heart, while the pizza card shows a dark circular background, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and style across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.
